name: Economy log: Manastorm floor rewards, the run's currency and a Manastorm Cache
contract: With the economy log on, every item the Manastorm module delivers (PrepareItemDelivery: a mail row first, moved into the bags of an online player) writes one reward row with source 4 (Manastorm) in the same transaction.
A level 60 non-Wildcard leader's first clear of test segment 1 (Taragaman 11520) gives the first-clear Bonus Manastorm Cache 1478051 (BONUS_CACHE_OTHER): one row.

Stopping the run settles the floor's held-back currency (Bonzo Bolts 1297308, Bedlam Bullion 1297307, Runes of Ascension 375250): exactly one row for the Bonzo Bolts (one stack; BONZO pays 336 at depth 1, at most x1.4 for the group and x2 for the segment).
A Manastorm Cache (11-24) 97877 opens through the loot window: its item is one cache_open row with the cache as source.
